0732Building and civil engineering

FloodGate v1

bpHigh/FloodGate

Operate four flood-control dams above Nashville through real 2025 floods, choosing releases to minimise flood cost.

Open on Hugging FaceHow to run it

Good for

  • operations research with LLM agents
  • live decisions under forecast uncertainty
  • deterministic, judge-free grading

Reward

How it is scored
Programmatic check
Signal
Graded, 0 to 1

Plan mode reward is 0.2 + 0.8 exp(-rho/0.25) against an LP optimum; live mode scores regret against a lazy operator; no LLM judge.

How to run it

1. Get the filesthe whole repository, to a local folder

hf download bpHigh/FloodGate --repo-type dataset --local-dir FloodGate
